exitCodes.meaning: The payload carries the path, the revision (absent for the working tree) and lines:[{oid, finalLine, originalLine, originalPath, author, authorEmail, authorTime, authorTimeZone, summary, isBoundary, content}].

Invalid arguments — not exactly one <path>, an unknown or duplicated flag, a flag value that is missing or starts with '-', or --lines that is not two positive integers <start>,<end> with start ≤ end.
The request failed for a reason the other codes do not name.
Not a repository, or git refused the blame — no such file (at that revision), an unknown revision, or a --lines range past the end of the file.

flags.help: Only the lines <start>,<end> — 1-based, inclusive, e.g. 10,20. Bounds the work as well as the output.
Blame the file as of <rev>. Without it, the working tree's file, with uncommitted lines given the all-zero oid.

summary: Show which commit last changed each line of a file (git blame). Read-only.
